47)༄༅/bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/48)skyabs sems ni/hūm̐/rang byung rig pa chos kyi sku/ /spang thob bral bar skyabs su mchi/

tei:div.tei:p: 47) ༄༅/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/ 48)

skyabs sems ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung rig pa chos kyi sku// spang thob bral bar skyabs su mchi// ma rtogs 'khrul par gol ba rnams// rang grol chen por sems bskyed do/ lan gsum/ 'gal rkyen bsal ba ni/ hūm̐/ gdod nas dag mnyam chen po'i klong*// ma dag 'khrul pa'i ming yang med// 'od gsal ye shes snying po'i mtshams// mi shigs rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ badzra rakṣaḥ mthun rkyen sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun khyab ye shes chen po la// cer mthong rang grol byin phob cig /'khrul rtog a 'thas mtshan 'dzin kun// rol rtsal shar grol byin gyis rlobs/ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshogs zhing sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid mngon sum de bzhin nyid// nyams snang gong 'phel snying rje'i gdangs// rig pa tshad phebs snod bcud kun// 'khrul rtog chos zad dag pa'i klong*// bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mdun mkhar 'ja' 'od zer thig klong*// 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas ni/ dkar gsal gzhon tshul paṇa grub chas// shes rab ral gri po ti bsnams/ 49)/dbu gtsug mkhan slob bī ma la// kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams sogs// snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa bzhugs// mtha' bskor mdun nas rim pa bzhin// jo bo rje dang blo bzang grags// rgyal bka' gdams pa 'char ba'i tshogs// birba pa dang gong ma lnga*// dgyes rdor lam 'bras 'phags pa'i tshogs// mar mi dwags po phag mo grub// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing dang*// ne gu khyung po rin chen bdun// shangs pa bka' rgyud grub pa'i dbang*// ra 'gro jo zhal rnam pa gnyis// dus kyi 'khor lo sbyor ba drug /dam pa ma gcig lab kyi sgron// zhi byed gcod yul brgyud pa'i tshogs// grub pa'i dbang phyug o rgyan pa// rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa// gangs can rgyal bstan gsal mdzad pa'i// sgrub brgyud shing rta che brgyad kyi// rig 'dzin yi dam chos skyong tshogs// dpag med khrom tshogs bzhin du gsal// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi brjid 'bar// gsang gsum rdo rje'i chos su grub// de las 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros// ye shes dkyil 'khor sa ma dzaḥ

spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ 50) /padma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub phyir// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol/ gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ 'od gsal dbyings nas ye shes sku// rang rig dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs// yongs grub chen po'i rang bzhin du// rang ngo shes pas brda phyag 'tshal// yul dang yul can thams cad kyang*// gzhi snang rig pa'i rtsal du snang*// dgag sgrub blang dor ye nas 'das// mnyam nyid chen por bzhes su gsol// gzung 'dzin rgyang chad ltar snang ba'i// ma rig 'khrul rtog ye nas sangs// rang rig rtsal du rang shar ba'i// ye yin lhun 'byams ngang du bshags// rang rig kun tu bzang po ni/ khyad du 'phags pa'i chos drug gi /tshogs chen ye rdzogs mngon byang brnyes/ khyab brdal chen por yi rang ngo// blo las 'das pa'i ye shes che// ma btsal ye nas rang la rdzogs// bya rtsol bral ba'i rdzogs pa che// 'od gsal chos 'khor bskor bar skul// kun khyab 'gyur med bla ma rje// 'pho med rdo rje'i skur bzhengs nas// nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba'i don// rtag khyab lhun grub bzhugs 51)su gsol// zag med ye shes 'dus ma byas// grol ba bzhi ldan dgongs pa'i klong*// cog bzhag bzhi yis mthar skyel ba'i// 'od lus 'grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'od gsal rang la gnas pa'i ye shes de// ma nor ma 'khrul mngon sum rtogs// ma yengs mi bsgom dus kun tu// chos nyid dgongs pa bar med shog /rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// thugs rgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs mchog /da lta nyid du bdag rgyud la// yongs su 'pho bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/

zhes bzla/ thun mtshams su tshogs mchod bya ba na ི/ hūm̐/ ka dag dbyings kyi tshogs gzhong du// lhun grub rig pa'i tshogs gtor bshams// zung 'jug thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams// rang snang ye shes tshogs la gshegs// khyab brdal chen por mchod pa 'bul// 'od gsal zang thal ngang du bshags// mtshan rtog 'byung ba dbyings su sgrol// rig rtsal rol pa'i lhag gtor bzhes// snang bzhi mthar phyin dngos grub stsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza utstshiṣṭa ba lingta khā hiḥ dbang len pa ni/ khyab gdal gnyug ma chos kyi sku// ye shes 52) rig pa'i dbang chen po// bskur thob bral ba'i gdeng thob pas// dbang mchog rgyal po ye nas rdzogs/ bsdu ldang ni/ gdod nas sku gsum rang la rdzogs// mi g.yo gsum ldan dgongs pa'i klong*// 'ub chub blo 'das ngang bzhag pas// gdeng bzhi'i grol tshad mngon du gyur// dge bsngo ni/ dge 'dis 'khrul rtog sems can kun// rang gnas dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs// gzhon nu bum skur mngon byang chub// gdod ma'i btsan sa zin par shog zhes pa'ang bla ma bde chen thugs bzhed bzhin 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros des bris pa dge/ maṅga lam/ ༈ skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings spros bral pho brang nas// longs spyod yongs rdzogs chu zla'i gar// bstan pa yongs rdzogs shing rta che// blo gros mtha' yas thugs dam bskang*/ mkhan slob bī ma klong chen sogs// snga 'gyur rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang*// jo bo rje dang tsong kha ba// bka' gdams rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang*/ /birbas pa dang gong ma lnga// lam 'bras rig 'dzin thugs= mar mi dwags po phag mo gru// karma bka' brgyud= ne gu khyung po rin chen bdun// shangs pa bka' brgyud= ra 'gro jo zhal rnam gnyis sogs/ 53) /sbyor drug rig 'dzin thugs dam= dam pa lab kyi sgron ma sogs// zhi gcod rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug o rgyan pa// bsnyen sgrub rig 'dzin thugs dam=

sgrub rgyud shing rta che brgyad kyi// rtsa gsum chos skyong thugs= bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas// nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis bshags// tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ zhes pa'ang bde chen thugs bzhed bzhin shrī dhīḥpas bris pa dge'o// 54)
